title: Halliburton Announces Dividend
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Halliburton's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 22, 2026-- Halliburton Company (NYSE: HAL) announced today that its board of directors has declared a 2026 third quarter dividend of seventeen cents ($0.17) a share on the Company’s common stock payable on September 23, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 2, 2026.


**About Halliburton**


Halliburton is one of the world’s leading providers of products and services to the energy industry. Founded in 1919, we create innovative technologies, products, and services that help our customers maximize their value throughout the life cycle of an asset and advance a sustainable energy future.
